limitations: Exploratory archive already inspected; inner validation does not undo analyst knowledge of 2025/2026 outcomes.
Configurations selected using only pre-2024-12-25 data in this retrospective run, not prospectively frozen in 2024.
One-SE uses the bootstrap SE of the best candidate mean loss. It is a simplicity heuristic, not a superiority or equivalence test.
Circular 4-calendar-week resampling retains empty weeks and market-count weighted means; wraparound and nonstationarity are limitations.
Ridge penalizes summed negative log likelihood including intercept. Fixed lambda corresponds to lambda/n in average-loss units.
Insufficient inner history permanently falls back to market-only but does not remove eligible outer rows.
Source odds observed_at, result available_at, complete schedules, historical xG/starter/bullpen/lineup snapshots are unavailable.
Same-day results are deferred until next day; quarterly coefficient updates use a 7-day embargo. Configuration choices never use post-selection-cutoff data.
Feature-set search, four penalties, one-SE and empirical-minimum strategies were specified after PR211 results. No production promotion allowed.
